speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: At dawn we crept out and down the road I had driven overnight.
heard: At dawn, we crept out and down the road I had driven overnight.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: People had dropped things as they ran. A clock. A slipper. A silver spoon.
heard: People had dropped things as they ran. A clock, a slipper, a silver spoon.

speaker: artilleryman
text: It's no kindness to the right sort of wife, to make her a widow.
heard: It is no kindness to the right sort of wife to make her a widow.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: In the pine woods, not a breath of wind. Even the birds were hushed.
heard: In the pine woods, not a breath of wind. Even the birds were hushed.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: We talked in whispers, and kept looking back over our shoulders.
heard: We talked in whispers and kept looking back over our shoulders.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Through the trees, three hussars were riding toward Woking. We hailed them.
heard: Through the trees, three hussars were riding toward woking. We hailed them.

speaker: artilleryman
text: Giants in armour, sir. A hundred feet high.
heard: Giants in armor, sir. A hundred feet high.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: It is perfectly true.
heard: It is perfectly true.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Weybridge was in a tumult. Everyone packing, and in their Sunday best.
heard: Weybridge was in a tumult, everyone packing and in their Sunday best.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: The soldiers could not make them understand what was coming.
heard: The soldiers could not make them understand what was coming.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: One shrivelled old fellow would not leave his pots of orchids behind.
heard: One shriveled old fellow would not leave his pots of orchids behind.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Death is coming! Death!
heard: Death is coming. Death.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: We ate what we had brought, on the step of the drinking fountain.
heard: We ate what we had brought on the step of the drinking fountain.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: By noon we were at Shepperton, where the Wey meets the Thames. Too few boats.
heard: By noon we were at Shepperton, where the way meets the Thames. Too few boats.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: A gun thudded toward Chertsey. Then a puff of smoke, far up the river.
heard: A gun thudded toward Chertsey, then a puff of smoke far up the river.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: One, two, three, four of them, striding across the meadows to the river.
heard: One, two, three, four of them, striding across the meadows to the river.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Get under the water!
heard: Get under the water.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: I turned and ran headlong into the river, toward the thing.
heard: I turned and ran headlong into the river, toward the thing.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: It waded halfway across. Then the six hidden guns at Shepperton fired together.
heard: It waded halfway across. Then the six hidden guns at Shepperton fired together.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: A shell burst clean in its face, and the brass hood flew apart.
heard: A shell burst clean in its face, and the brass hood flew apart.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Hit! They have hit it!
heard: Hit. They have hit it.

speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
text: Headless, it reeled on, struck down the church tower, and fell.
heard: Headless, it reeled on, struck down the church tower, and fell.

speaker: artilleryman
text: It is bows and arrows against the lightning, anyhow.
heard: It is bows and arrows against the lightning. Anyhow.
